title: Aether Dynamics — Q3 2018 cash cut-off retrospective
tagline: Would a tool-grounded agent have surfaced the cash that was not there?

breaks.sec_theme: Cash reported that never cleared a controlled bank account (affiliate / 'cash in transit' window dressing).
Period-end cash cut-off: collection booked before the remittance hit the bank.
Unrecorded bank fee — small, but proves bank-only evidence is retained.

methodology: Reconstructed illustration. Amounts and entity names are synthetic. Break *patterns* mirror themes repeatedly documented in SEC Accounting and Auditing Enforcement Releases on cash cut-off and improper cash reporting. Vendor names Dell Federal Systems L.P. and Regents of the University of California appear in public USAspending award data bundled with this repo and are used only as realistic counterparty color — not as an allegation about those recipients.
